SUMMARY DASHBOARD
One verdict banner up top, six KPI tiles on an even grid, a compact 3-row table, and the six charts in a clean 3x2 grid with real axis labels and legends. Nothing overlaps, everything is the same size class.

GENERAL INFORMATION
Two-column form (Airport | Project) instead of one tall column, the LCCA parameters as a single six-up band, and the navigation buttons collapsed into one action toolbar. Cuts the vertical scroll by roughly 40%.
